scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Select an option.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请选择一个选项。

scripts.text: Turn ON/OFF Event
scripts.translation: 开启/关闭活动

scripts.text: Event Settings
scripts.translation: 活动设置

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Event is currently: [^FF0000OFF^000000]
Would you like to turn it ON?
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
当前活动状态：[^FF0000关闭^000000]
要开启活动吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Pick a setting to modify.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请选择要修改的设置。

scripts.text: Monster Display
scripts.translation: 魔物显示

scripts.text: Number of Rounds
scripts.translation: 回合数

scripts.text: Prize Settings
scripts.translation: 奖励设置

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Choose a disguise rule.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请选择变装规则。

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Disguise Rule has been set:
  > ^0055FFDisguise as all monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
变装规则已设置为：
  > ^0055FF伪装成所有魔物。^000000

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Disguise Rule has been set:
  > ^0055FFDisguise as MVPs only.^000000
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
变装规则已设置为：
  > ^0055FF仅伪装成MVP。^000000

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Disguise Rule has been set:
  > ^0055FF{0}^000000

[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Input the number of rounds you want the event to last.
Current number: [^0000FF10^000000]
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请输入活动持续的回合数。
当前回合数：[^0000FF10^000000]

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The number of rounds has been changed to {0}.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
活动回合数已更改为{0}。

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Input the Item ID of the prize given each round.
Current item: [^0000FF{0}^000000] (ID #512)
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请输入每轮发放的奖励物品ID。
当前物品：[^0000FF{0}^000000]（ID #512）

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Input the amount to be given.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
请输入发放数量。

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
That item does not exist. Please try again.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
该物品不存在，请重试。

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
That amount is invalid. Using default amount of 1.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
数量无效，将使用默认数量1。

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Prize has been changed successfully.
Prize: {0}x [^0000FF{1}^000000]

[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
The Prize has been changed successfully.
Prize: 1x [^0000FF{0}^000000]

[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
Welcome.
How may I be of assistance?
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
欢迎。
有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 了解规则

scripts.text: Nothing, just passing through.
scripts.translation: 没什么，只是路过

scripts.text:
[^0000FFDisguise NPC^000000]
This event is quite simple.
At the start of the event, I will
disguise myself as a random
monster. You have to shout
that monster's name out loud.
scripts.translation:
[^0000FF变装活动NPC^000000]
这个活动很简单。
活动开始时，我会随机变成一种魔物。
你们必须大声喊出那种魔物的名字。

scripts.text:
If you are correct, you will receive
a prize. If not, keep trying!
That's all that there is to this event.
scripts.translation:
答对就能获得奖励，答错就继续试！
活动就是这么简单。
